meta.title: Frequently asked questions | Intello
meta.description: Answers about Intello's services, who we work with, how to get started and how we look after your data.

header.title: Frequently
header.lede: What people usually ask before getting started. If you do not see your answer, write to us.

items.question: What does Intello offer?
answer: Cargo monitoring, AI business intelligence, technology services and back office for logistics companies. You can choose one or combine them.

items.question: Is Intello a logistics company?
answer: No. We do not transport or store cargo. We are a technology and data provider for logistics companies.

items.question: Which companies do you work with?
answer: Couriers, 3PL operators and freight and transport companies.

items.question: How do we get started?
answer: Request a demo from the contact page.
We get in touch to understand your operation and suggest the services that fit.

items.question: Do you connect to my systems?
answer: Yes. We build integrations through APIs and agree the details with you at the start.

items.question: What exactly does the AI do?
answer: It sends end-customer alerts, forecasts demand and feeds KPI dashboards. It works alongside your team and saves it repetitive tasks.

items.question: How do you protect my data?
answer: We use data only to deliver the service. On this site we only collect what you send in the contact form and we use no third-party analytics.
